Lost something already? Should've minded your purse. I did say.
...I was going to say.
Low Town folk keep asking the Watch about missing children. The Captain says Low Town is always losing people.
Says that's what Low Town is _for._ I didn't laugh. He noticed.
Mercy Vale. I gave her a nod every morning at this gate. She'd bless my boots.
I've thrown the boots in the river.
Heading south? The Pilgrim Road runs straight to the Sunscar. Take water.
Take more water than that.
HEAR YE! His Holiness the Hierophant returns from the western isles! The Grand Lantern burns bright!
Also bread is up a copper!
HEAR YE! The Choir reminds all citizens that the Undercroft is CLOSED and CONDEMNED and NOT A PLACE FOR CHILDREN!
Also bread is up another copper!
HEAR YE! Sister Mercy Vale is CAST OUT of the Choir! A reward for information on her whereabouts!
And bread is DOWN a copper, by order of the Hierophant! Long live the Hierophant!
River's low. The Aure's never this low in autumn.
The old bargemen say the sea's pulling at it, way out west. Like it's holding its breath.
Hettie says I'm to rest. I'm resting standing up. It's a baker's skill.
I dream about the singing, sometimes. Then I wake up and there's bread to make. It helps, the bread.
Saltglass pepper! Sunscar cumin! Dried figs from the caravan roads!
The Keeper down south, Tamsin — blind as a stone, they say, and sees more than you or me. She told my caravan-master the day he'd die.
He's been avoiding that day ever since. Very successfully.
South? To Saltglass? Give Keeper Tamsin my regards.
...Actually, don't. She'll know exactly who I am.
Behold! Fenwick the Fabulous juggles THREE bells—
—two bells. Behold! Two bells.
A new act, in honor of the brave children of the Undercroft! I shall juggle FOUR bells!
In honor of the brave children, I shall juggle two bells.
Did you see the Hierophant's ship come in? The _Aubade._ White as milk, sails like folded wings.
Fastest ship in the world. Lucky for him. Some of us walk.
Fourteen people brought up out of the Undercroft! They say a girl from the islands led them. The Hierophant's own Page!
...Wait. Is that—
The Bell Market's been here six hundred years. Prices have been going up for five hundred and ninety-nine of them.
The first year was lovely, they say.
Forty years ago this autumn, the Lantern went out for one night. I was nine.
My mother held her hand over my eyes until dawn. I've come every day since to thank it. For coming back.
Some didn't come back, that night. Three hundred and twelve, they say. The Keeper's own daughter among them.
The Hierophant was her brother, you know. Twelve years old. He saw it all.
The Grand Lantern is open to the Choir only, citizen.
Admire it from there. It's very admirable from there.
Eyes front. No touching the Lantern. No singing at the Lantern. No proposing marriage at the Lantern — we've had a spate.
The Lord-Commander's doubled the watch. Every Sister of Small Mercies is under guard.
They just sit in the almshouse and sing. Quietly. All day. I've asked for a transfer.
The dawn-office is at first bell. The noon-office at noon. The dusk-office... you can see where this is going.
We've been told not to speak of Sister Mercy. So I won't.
...She taught me my letters. When I was small. She was so patient.
I walked from Mirefen to see the Grand Lantern. Three weeks. My feet are a disgrace.
There's a sickness in the swamp. Mother Osk says it's the Gloam, getting into the water. Nobody listens to Mother Osk.
Then again, she's usually right.
Lantern resonance! The Seven Lanterns sing at seven _slightly_ different pitches. A sloppiness I find personally offensive.
Brother Halvard of Frosthollow wrote a monograph on it. Wrong, mostly. Elegantly wrong.
Tuning forks, to bring the Lanterns into harmony? ...Fascinating.
Dangerous, if it were done wrong, of course. A Lantern tuned to the wrong note would — well. Everything worth doing is dangerous.
My Kindling's next spring. Father says I'll be an Arcanist, because Father was an Arcanist, and Father's father.
I want to be a Ranger. ...Don't tell Father.
Is that a _street kid?_ Father says street kids bite.
Only on Tuesdays.
...Is it Tuesday?
Did you hear? The Hierophant has taken a Page. Some girl from the islands. _Fishing_ people.
Can you imagine? Smelling of mackerel, in the Cathedral.
I always said that Mercy woman smiled too much.
